string.text: Operation failed. The threat remains — expect fallout on nearby locations.
Cleanup progress: current operation success chance —
Contribution reward issued. Items are in the shelter reward box.

Attention, stalkers! A dangerous mutant concentration has been detected. A ceasefire is in effect. Experienced hunters are asked to help clear it — for your aid I guarantee reputation with all circles, medicine, money and supplies.
Excellent — this will substantially help the cleanup progress!
A dangerous mutant squad was destroyed; the lab continues monitoring.
Attention! An especially strong mutant squad has appeared on the location. Destroy it — this is critical for the cleanup. The squad is marked on your map.
Operation successful. The stalkers contained the threat.
Attention, stalkers: the ceasefire still holds for a while, but peaceful hunters are asked to evacuate.
Attention, stalkers: the ceasefire is about to end. Peaceful hunters — evacuate immediately!
Attention, stalkers: the ceasefire still holds for about two hours. Peaceful hunters should prepare to evacuate.
Ceasefire over. I repeat — ceasefire over.

Attention, stalkers: our instruments show a significant drop in mutant activity! Excellent — together we have weathered the crisis! The ceasefire will remain in effect for a while longer so you can collect trophies, aid the wounded, and evacuate peaceful hunters.
